notes.title: Military Logistics Simulator Demo Update 2
notes.notes: [p][b]Attention![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing Military Logistics Simulator during Next Fest. The festival is over, but we have decided to leave the demo running for a little while longer. We have also uploaded one more update to include some of your feedback. [/p][p]Among a bunch of smaller fixes, the changes include modified mission dialogue and new encubrance mechanics. Also, settings menus will scale better to different types of monitors. Have fun with the demo, wishlist the game to receive news and updates, and let us know what you think about the changes. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Stay vigilant![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Nano Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Military Logistics Simulator Demo Update
notes.notes: [p][b][i]Soldiers![/i][/b][i] [/i][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing the Military Logistics Simulator demo and sending us your opinions. We've updated the demo to include as much of your feedback as possible during Next Fest. What are the changes about? [/p][p]There's more focus put on the missions you seem to like the most - the ones regarding the defense of the base. And there's a little more combat, too. Also, we've been working on performance. And some bugs have been squashed. [/p][p][/p][p]We hope you'll enjoy the changes. [/p][p][i]Stay vigilant![/i] [/p][p][b][i]Nano Games Team[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ First Look at Military Logistics Simulator | Demo Gameplay 🚛
notes.notes: [p][b]Join us as we dive into the free demo of Military Logistics Simulator by Nano Games![/b] [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="GHAephWY4FM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Take control of military logistics operations, manage vehicles, expand your base, and deliver critical supplies – solo or in co-op with friends. 🐕 [/p][p][/p][p]Includes real military vehicles, UAVs, base building, and even a loyal German Shepherd for rescue missions! 🎮 [/p][p][/p][p]Play the free demo now on Steam: [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2947540/Military_Logistics_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
